## About פיצה צ'יזי לוק
Cheesy Look Pizza is a highly-rated (4.8 stars) local pizzeria located in Gan Yavne, Israel, known for its affordable prices (1–50 NIS per person). The restaurant offers both self-pickup and delivery options, operates late (until 0:30), and maintains an active WhatsApp presence for orders. The brand has a casual, neighborhood-friendly vibe with a focus on accessibility and convenience.
